1) Delete only that single occurrence on Tue Jul 14, 2026 at 9:00 AM (leave the rest of the weekly series intact), or
2) Delete the entire recurring series (remove all occurrences going forward and past)?

Also: should I send cancellation notices to attendees (if any)? Please confirm option 1 or 2 and whether to notify attendees, and I’ll proceed.
